Depth order here comes from playing time only.

Players are ranked by the snaps they played in that position group and phase. Rank 1 is the playing-time starter. Jersey number, experience, salary and any printed depth chart play no part in this order. Where two players tie on snaps, the order is alphabetical by name and the tie is visible in the table.
